Good trip in part.
Oct 2026 • Solo
The trip itself was good. We had plenty of time to take pics before the weather changed. Staff were quick to offer to move us inside, although i was moved to a small, hot, back room that wasnt very nice. Staff were generally very good although I did feel pressured into leaving a positive review before the end of the cruise, with the staff standing over me to take a photo of my review submission on GYG. They came for payment at 8.45pm, so no option for a glass of wine after that. Food was fine. Nothing special. ¹pNot sure what was fusion about it other than Teryaki sauce for the salmon. Despite this it was a good trip to start with but felt a bit forgotten after I'd paid.

Thank you for sharing your experience with us. We’re glad you enjoyed the beginning of your cruise, but we’re truly sorry that the evening didn’t end as pleasantly as it began.

Your feedback means a great deal to us, and we’ll share it with our team so we can learn and improve. We hope to have another opportunity to welcome you back and provide the warm, memorable experience you deserve.
